properties.description: crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/a_near_match_across_types_or_within_reasoning_is_a_note.rs, in the in_memory test program. Four tests. (1) Every checking constructor against nine other seed types is written and reports the match with its type; on the old code 26 of the 45 pairs refused. (2) Two statements carrying a statement_kind are written beside each other. (3) A same-type match outside a line of reasoning, or with only one side a statement, still refuses with all three answers. (4) Proof trial rung 2's 49 statements are replayed against the rest of the design with no distinct_from; on the old code 45 of 49 refused (34 with a same-type statement match, 11 cross-type only), now none. The older layer-wording tests (a_near_match_of_another_type_is_named_as_a_layer.rs, a_prescribed_layer_pair_no_longer_refuses.rs) were moved to the rule.
properties.findings: 4 passed (cargo test -p reflow2-mcp --no-default-features --test in_memory, 2026-10-17, branch feat/near-matches-note-and-reasoning-pages); the whole in_memory program 773 passed after the toolsnap update.
properties.name: A near-match across types or within reasoning is a note (4 MCP tests)
